subject: Procurement routing and readiness — next owner & timeline
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivepay.com>, OlivePay Procurement <procurement@olivepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement routing and readiness — next owner & timeline

Hi Samira — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pilot scope: 5k tokens/month for proof-of-concept (1 small model endpoint).
- Security checklist: SOC 2 report + data retention controls required by procurement.
- Preferred commercial path: Finance prefers PO for vendors; purchase card possible for initial pilot if procurement agrees.
- Marketplace interest: OlivePay asked whether Redwood’s marketplace listing would shorten procurement cycle.

What Redwood will do (attachments included)
- Share mutual action plan + draft SOW for DocuSign-ready review (attached).
- Provide vendor form template and vendor information packet.
- Loop in Marissa for pricing/terms and Neha for security artifacts.

Ask for OlivePay
- Confirm which procurement route you intend to pursue (PO vs card vs marketplace) and who the internal owner will be (name & email).
- If PO, please share any required vendor form fields or a link to your form.

Proposed timeline & cadence
- Suggest weekly 15-min check-ins Friday 10:00 AM PT starting 2027-03-19 to unblock procurement.
- Goal: signed pilot by end of March or earliest available date from your finance team.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the vendor form link and HubSpot deal update after I hear from you.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: OlivePay Procurement <procurement@olivepay.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement routing and readiness — next owner & timeline

Hi Jonas — great recap, thank you. A few responses from procurement/finance: 

- Finance preference: PO for vendor relationships. That said, for a small pilot (~$5k) they are open to using a corporate card to speed things up as long as Procurement signs off.
- Procurement asks for: our vendor form (we’ll fill it) + a DocuSign-ready SOW and evidence of SOC 2 (or attestation).
- Marketplace: sounds promising if Redwood is listed on our cloud marketplace, but legal will still want to review marketplace terms; that can add ~1–2 weeks.

Internal owner: I’ll be the primary contact initially and will loop Lydia Park (procurement) once we have the vendor form to circulate.

Weekly check-ins: Friday 10 AM PT works for me. Please send the vendor form link and I’ll push this internally.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships | OlivePay
samira.khan@olivepay.com | +1 (212) 555-8842
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement routing and readiness — suggested split of ownership

Looping in my suggested approach so we can be aligned before committing dates to OlivePay: 

Suggested playbook
- Commercial owner: Marissa (I’ll own pricing, PO language, and DocuSign SOW finalization).
- Security owner: Neha (supply SOC 2 + short answers to procurement security Qs).
- Pilot payment: Offer PO as primary route; provide card as a fallback for immediate pilot activation (limit $5k).
- Marketplace: Offer as an optional fast-path but only if OlivePay is comfortable with marketplace terms; note that listing/onboarding adds legal steps.

Ask for Jonas
- Confirm you shared vendor-form-template.pdf and the HubSpot deal link with Samira.
- Can you schedule a 30-min procurement huddle with Lydia + OlivePay finance for Thursday 2027-03-17 (I can attend if needed)?

I’ll prepare a redlined PO clause template and a DocuSign SOW to shorten handoffs.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement routing and readiness — next steps and quick link bundle

Samira — quick update and concrete asks below. Repeating Marissa/Neha’s owners so OlivePay has a single point for each track. 

What I’m sending now
- Vendor form template (vendor-form-template.pdf) attached. Please use or paste into your form and we’ll return completed items the same day.
- HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/OD-4382

Owners
- Commercial/contract negotiator: Marissa Cole
- Security/compliance: Neha Kapoor

Proposed next steps (please confirm)
1) Samira to confirm whether Procurement will issue a PO or prefer card for the pilot.
2) If PO: identify the signer and preferred PO routing (purchase order number + vendor code).
3) If card: confirm cardholder and single-charge limit for pilot.
4) If they want marketplace: Samira to confirm and we’ll route legal review (adds ~1–2 weeks).
5) Weekly 15-min cadence Fridays 10:00 AM PT starting 2027-03-19 — confirm attendees.

I can host the procurement huddle on 2027-03-17 if that is still possible — let me know time windows and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: vendor-form-template.pdf (attached), mutual-action-plan.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into procurement.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: OlivePay Procurement <procurement@olivepay.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement routing and readiness — vendor form + pilot payment path

Thanks Jonas — update from procurement/finance after review: 

- Procurement asked us to collect the vendor form and a DocuSign-ready SOW. If Redwood can provide the SOW in DocuSign-ready format that will speed signature.
- Finance preference remains PO for the full production contract. For the pilot, they are willing to approve a corporate card charge up to $5k to avoid delays; procurement will still need to approve the vendor and record the transaction.
- Marketplace is something we’re interested in but legal flagged it for review; expect +1–2 weeks if we go that route.

Procurement contact: Lydia Park <lydia.park@olivepay.com> — I’ll introduce Lydia on the vendor form thread once I have the filled form from Redwood.

Weekly calls: Friday 10 AM PT is confirmed starting 2027-03-19. I’ll invite Lydia and finance to the recurring meeting.

I’ll expect the DocuSign SOW and completed vendor form by COB tomorrow so we can circulate internally.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships | OlivePay
